# Character properties

The canonical combining class and the White_Space, Alphabetic and Numeric properties of a scalar value.

<h2 id="combining-class-of"><code>CombiningClassOf</code></h2>

```rux
pub func CombiningClassOf(scalar: char32) -> uint32
```

The canonical combining class of `scalar`: zero for nearly everything, and the reordering key for marks.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Properties.rux#L86)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type     | Description                  |
| -------- | -------- | ---------------------------- |
| `scalar` | `char32` | the scalar value to classify |

**Returns**: its canonical combining class, zero for a starter

<h2 id="is-white-space"><code>IsWhiteSpace</code></h2>

```rux
pub func IsWhiteSpace(scalar: char32) -> bool
```

Whether `scalar` is whitespace by Unicode's `White_Space` property.
A superset of ASCII's six: the no-break spaces, the typographic spaces and the line and paragraph separators
are all here, which is what separates this from `Text`'s deliberately ASCII-only trimming.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Properties.rux#L96)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type     | Description              |
| -------- | -------- | ------------------------ |
| `scalar` | `char32` | the scalar value to test |

**Returns**: whether it has the White_Space property

<h2 id="is-alphabetic"><code>IsAlphabetic</code></h2>

```rux
pub func IsAlphabetic(scalar: char32) -> bool
```

Whether `scalar` is alphabetic by the derived `Alphabetic` property.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Properties.rux#L104)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type     | Description              |
| -------- | -------- | ------------------------ |
| `scalar` | `char32` | the scalar value to test |

**Returns**: whether it has the Alphabetic property

<h2 id="is-numeric"><code>IsNumeric</code></h2>

```rux
pub func IsNumeric(scalar: char32) -> bool
```

Whether `scalar` is numeric: a decimal digit, a letterlike number, or another number form.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Properties.rux#L112)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type     | Description              |
| -------- | -------- | ------------------------ |
| `scalar` | `char32` | the scalar value to test |

**Returns**: whether it has the Numeric_Type property
